# `adt changeset`

Transactional unit-of-work — batch lock/PUT/activate (Wave 3)

```bash
adt changeset [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                  | Description                                                  |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `adt changeset begin`    | Open a new transactional changeset                           |
| `adt changeset add`      | Stage an object write into an open changeset (lock + PUT)    |
| `adt changeset commit`   | Batch-activate every staged object and release locks         |
| `adt changeset rollback` | Release locks held by a changeset (source PUTs not reverted) |

## `adt changeset begin`

Open a new transactional changeset

```bash
adt changeset begin [options]
```

**Options**

| Option                     | Description                             | Default   |
| -------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `-d, --description <text>` | Optional description                    |           |
| `-s, --system <systemId>`  | Logical system bucket for on-disk state | `default` |
| `--json`                   | Emit the changeset as JSON              | `false`   |

## `adt changeset add`

Stage an object write into an open changeset (lock + PUT)

```bash
adt changeset add [options]
```

**Options**

| Option                    | Description                                              | Default   |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `--changeset <id>`        | Changeset id from `changeset begin` (required)           |           |
| `--object-name <name>`    | ABAP object name                                         |           |
| `--object-type <type>`    | Object type (PROG, CLAS, INTF, FUGR, INCL)               |           |
| `--object-uri <uri>`      | Explicit ADT object URI (overrides name/type resolution) |           |
| `--source <source>`       | New source code (inline)                                 |           |
| `--source-file <path>`    | Path to a file whose contents replace the source         |           |
| `--transport <tr>`        | Transport request                                        |           |
| `-s, --system <systemId>` | Logical system bucket for on-disk state                  | `default` |
| `--json`                  | Emit the updated entry as JSON                           | `false`   |

## `adt changeset commit`

Batch-activate every staged object and release locks

```bash
adt changeset commit [options]
```

**Options**

| Option                    | Description                             | Default   |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `--changeset <id>`        | Changeset id (required)                 |           |
| `-s, --system <systemId>` | Logical system bucket for on-disk state | `default` |
| `--json`                  | Emit the commit result as JSON          | `false`   |

## `adt changeset rollback`

Release locks held by a changeset (source PUTs not reverted)

```bash
adt changeset rollback [options]
```

**Options**

| Option                    | Description                             | Default   |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `--changeset <id>`        | Changeset id (required)                 |           |
| `-s, --system <systemId>` | Logical system bucket for on-disk state | `default` |
| `--json`                  | Emit the rollback result as JSON        | `false`   |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
